name: Côte de Nuits

known.via: English Wikipedia "Côte de Nuits" (a wine place on Wikidata)

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

keyfacts: The Côte de Nuits covers fourteen communes, and six of them produce grand cru wines.
There are 24 Grand Cru vineyards clustered around six villages, and more than 100 Premier Cru vineyards across the region.
Since the mid 19th century nearly all Premier and Grand Cru vineyards have been planted entirely to Pinot Noir.

blurb.text: The northern part of the Côte d'Or, from Dijon to just south of Nuits-Saint-Georges. It is most famous for reds made from Pinot Noir. Six of its fourteen communes produce grand cru wines.
